texto.@es: **Should have + participio** expresa lo que habría sido mejor o correcto y a menudo implica que no se hizo: **I should have left earlier; I missed the train.** También puede expresar una expectativa pasada, así que importa el contexto.
texto.@en: **Should have + participio** expresses what would have been best or right and often implies that it was not done: **I should have left earlier; I missed the train.** can also express a past expectation, so it matters the context.

texto.@es: **Could have + participio** presenta una posibilidad u oportunidad pasada. En **You could have called me**, el contexto puede convertirlo en un reproche; la forma por sí sola no siempre expresa crítica ni demuestra que la acción no ocurrió.
texto.@en: **Could have + participio** presents a past possibility or opportunity. In **You could have called me**, the context can turn it into a reproach; the form alone does not always express criticism or show that the action did not occur.

analisis.@en: It would have been better to get out before; he didn't.

frases.en: He could have taken the 8:30 bus, but he went home instead without texting Nina.

intro.@es: **Should have** y **could have** hablan del pasado, pero comunican ideas distintas. El contexto también puede cambiar el tono.
intro.@en: **Should have** and **could have** talk about the past, but they communicate different ideas. The context can also change the tone.
